ohtani.title: Oneil Cruz's two-run homer (16)
ohtani.blurb: Oneil Cruz crushes a two-run homer to center field, tying the game at 4-4 in the top of the 8th inning

imanaga.title: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits two homers in Cubs' win
imanaga.blurb: Pete Crow-Armstrong hits a walk-off and leadoff homer, and Shota Imanaga strikes out 10 in the Cubs' 7-5 win over the White Sox

suzuki.title: Leo Rivas' walk-off single
suzuki.blurb: Leo Rivas walks it off with a single to center field, winning it 6-5 for the Mariners

yoshida.title: Sonny Gray, Wilyer Abreu shine in 4-0 shutout win
yoshida.blurb: Seven innings of shutout ball from Sonny Gray and Wilyer Abreu's 22nd homer of the year lead the Red Sox to a 4-0 win over the Pirates

okamoto.title: Spencer Jones, Cam Schlittler fuel Yankees’ 3-1 win
okamoto.blurb: Spencer Jones crushes a two-run home run and Cam Schlittler twirls six innings of one-run ball to lead the Yankees to a 3-1 win over the Blue Jays\n

murakami.title: Jake Rogers smashes walk-off home run in 6-4 win
murakami.blurb: Jake Rogers smashes a walk-off two-run homer and the White Sox hit back-to-back-to-back home runs in Chicago's 6-4 win over the Mets

matsui.title: Carson Benge, Robert Stock lift Mets to a 4-2 victory
matsui.blurb: Carson Benge crushes a two-run home run in the 4th inning and Robert Stock strikes out six to lead the Mets to a 4-2 victory over the Padres
